newsitem.title: USA: Southern Union settles overcharge claims.
newsitem.headline: Southern Union settles overcharge claims.

text.p: Southern Union Co said Monday that its Missouri Gas Energy division had reached a global settlement to resolve complaints of overbilling brought by the Office of Public Counsel and the Missouri Public Service Commission.
Southern Union said the settlement calls for Missouri Gas to credit about $1.5 million to customers who were allegedly overbilled for gas this past winter.
It also calls for Missouri Gas to contribute $550,000 to a social service group to help needy Missouri Gas customers pay their gas bills.

Southern Union said the complaints arose primarily from billing errors made during the past winter's heating season. It said the errors resulted in overbillings of about $550,000 and underbillings of about $360,000.

Southern Union is a gas distribution company serving about 968,000 customers through two divisions, Southern Union Gas and Missouri Gas Energy. Missouri Gas serves about 471,000 customers in western Missouri.
